_task: read n, then n integers (up to 10^12 each); print their sum, then YES if the sum is even else NO

programs.python:
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    s = sum(int(x) for x in data[1:1 + n])
    print(s)
    print("YES" if s % 2 == 0 else "NO")

main()
